_comment: OpenSearch mapping fragment for FRAM spherical index fields. Send to Cesnet to inject into the FRAM index mapping (likely mappings/os-v2/fram-v1.0.0.json). See FRAM_spherical_index_impl v2.md, Section 6, for details and priority.

_priority_1_center_geo_blocker._comment: PRIORITY: blocker for primary cone search (October 2026 deadline). Without this, center_geo lands as a generic object and geo_distance queries fail entirely. healpix_idx works as a plain integer without any mapping change, but is included here for completeness/confirmation.

_priority_2_footprint_deferrable._comment: LOWER PRIORITY: optional, for second-pass position re-checking only (not the primary search UI). Deferrable past October 2026. Request separately, after center_geo is confirmed working.

_questions_for_cesnet: What is the exact path of the live FRAM index mapping file (expected: mappings/os-v2/fram-v1.0.0.json)?
What is the re-index procedure once the mapping is updated (existing records need center_geo/footprint re-indexed from source)?
Can center_geo (priority 1) be applied independently of / ahead of footprint (priority 2)?
